senses.gloss: (√אם, v. אֵם; cmp. preced.) to be strong, enduring; (act. v. אָמַן to support, v.
units: II Kings XVIII, 16 אֹמְנוֹת).—Pi. אִימֵּן, אִמֵּן to support; trnsf. to confirm, verify, approve.

<cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 1:4">Tosef. Ter. I, 4</cite> it is not the minor that made it T’rumah <he>אלא אביו שאִימֵּן אחריו</he> Var. (ed. Zuck. <he>שאומן</he>) but his father who confirmed his act (= <cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 1:4">ib.</cite> <he>קיים על יד</he>); Y. ib. 40ᵇ <he>א׳ על ידו</he>. Ib.ᶜ top <he>מְאַמֵּין</he>.

senses.gloss: part. נֶאֱמָן m., נֶאֱמָנֶת f. approved, trustworthy, reliable.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Peah 8:2">Peah VIII, 2</cite> <he>נֶאֱמָנִים על וכ׳</he> (the poor) may be relied upon concerning garnered fruit &c., i.e. if they declare the fruits to be the poor man’s share, they are exempt from tithes.
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 1:6">Keth. I, 6</cite> <he>נאמנת</he> her statement is acted upon as true.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 16b:16">Ab. Zar. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>נ׳ עלי הדיין</he> my judge is a reliable witness concerning me, i.e. I appeal to thy own judgment that I could not have engaged in such follies.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Demai 2:2">Dem. II, 2</cite> if one resolves <he>להיות נ׳</he> to be one of the reliable (conscientious in giving tithes); a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be confirmed. Y. Sot. II, 18ᵇ top אמן יֵאָמְנוּ הדברים Amen means, May the words (of the oath) be fulfilled.
(b. h.) to declare trustworthy, to trust, believe in.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Demai 7:1">Dem. VII, 1</cite> <he>והוא אינו מַאֲמִינוֹ</he> but he (the invited guest) trusts him not in tithe affairs.

Ab. Zar. 16ᵇ הואיל וְהֶאֱמַנְתַּנִי עליך ed. Pes., En Yak. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note; ed. הָאֳמַנְתִּי Hof.; since thou didst declare me a reliable witness unto thyself (appealing to my judgment), v. supra; [Ms. M. האמנת עלי thou reliedst on me]. Ch., v. הֵימַן.
